drone_interaction.vision_modality: Multi-spectral NIR rhizome occlusion mapping & root-rot fluorescence
drone_interaction.harvest_tool: Gantry dual-blade root-severing spatula with high-pressure fluid wash

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: TRPA1 ion channel agonist triggering transient neurovascular clearance; broad-spectrum microbial cell membrane lysis
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Potent antimicrobial action against foodborne pathogens and respiratory decongestant
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Liberated enzymatically via cell disruption on micro-grater

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Inhibition of platelet aggregation and activation of ARE-mediated phase II detoxifying enzymes
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Cardioprotection, anti-thrombotic activity, and neuroprotective antioxidant signaling
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Direct consumption of fresh rhizome paste within 15 minutes of grating

penalties_and_risks: Long 15-to-18 month vegetative cycle increases vulnerability to system interruptions.
Requires chilled, highly-oxygenated water (DO > 8.0 mg/L); temperatures above 18C trigger Pythium root rot.
human_culinary_use: Signature pungent, clean heat with sweet vegetal undertones. Grated fresh into sauces, sushi condiments, or pickled stems (wasabi-zuke).
